|notes=This is the numbered white-on-black presentation of Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V). The Players Committee distributed it as Virtual Set #1a through Decipher. Both numbered PDFs record creation on 6 March 2002 and state tournament legality from 9 March. The numbered sheets print collector mark 1•11 with identical words and game values in the two ink layouts. The 2006 wording calls the same device “this device” and reverses the order of the two cards it can cancel. Other editions include [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Original unnumbered)|Original (unnumbered)]], [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered black-on-white)|Numbered (black-on-white)]], [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium)|Premium]], [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070117223920/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1a.pdf Virtual Set #1a], [[Players Committee]], hosted by [[Decipher]], p. 1, numbered white-on-black slip 11. PDF creation metadata: 6 March 2002; printed tournament legality: 9 March 2002.
